title: 3-AMINOCARBONYL-N-BENZYL-1,4-DIHYDROQUINOLINE: A NOVEL NADH MODEL COMPOUND WHICH RESISTS THE ACID CATALYZED DECOMPOSITION
abstract: Abstract                The title NADH model compound resists acids unlike the conventional NADH model compounds. Thus, added acids accelerate the reduction of a carbonyl substrate selectively in the general-acid catalyzed manner.
